create_fuyu_processor: create a FuyuProcessor instance from pretrained image processor and tokenizer for multimodal image-text tasks
build_tokenized_image_text_batch: build a tokenized batch encoding with input_ids, image_patches, and image_patches_indices from images and text prompts
post_process_box_coordinates: post-process generated output tokens to extract and rescale bounding box coordinates back to original image space
post_process_image_text_to_text: post-process generated token sequences to decode only the text portion starting from the beginning-of-answer token
get_sample_encoding: get a single sample encoding with image patches, token IDs, and patch indices for a prompt-image pair
